body: DOCS EVIDENCE UPDATE. The 50 of 50 offline amrlib qualification closes the prior no-runtime statement at the runtime layer, but it does not yet make arbitrary-prose story modeling a delivered library capability. Until P1R lands, the capability tour may say: a pinned local runtime has deterministic checked-PENMAN coverage on the 50-sentence WOG segmentation; provider-to-PropositionChart-to-NarrativeCompilation-to-downstream-alignment integration, held-out evidence, and the admitted transcript vertical remain open. Never describe the 50 of 50 result as semantic accuracy; it is syntactic coverage and replay. After P1R, add one receipted executable workflow from admitted text through PinnedRuntime, typed per-item outcomes, checked PENMAN, checked PropositionChart, NarrativeCompilation, and P/F alignment, retaining failures and abstentions and one inspectable static visual. The deterministic fake remains transport evidence only. This updates the existing capability-tour needs-bead without changing code-red priority or claiming a docs milestone.
